name: Lift Rock For Eggs
desc:
🥚 Welcome to Lift Rock for Eggs!

How to Play:
💪 Train to gain Strength + Speed
🪨 Lift rocks to uncover eggs
🥚 Collect eggs hidden underneath
🐣 Hatch eggs to collect rare pets
💰 Earn money from your pets
⬆️ Upgrade to lift bigger rocks
✨ Discover rarer eggs and more powerful pets!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
